name: Astrid Lindström
bio:
Astrid Lindström's career began in the world of telecommunications, where she quickly rose through the ranks thanks to her sharp technical skills and knack for problem-solving. After years of building and managing IT infrastructure for major corporations, she decided to combine her professional expertise with her lifelong passion for motorsport. The allure of fast cars and cutting-edge technology was simply too strong to resist.

At V8 Masters Racing, Astrid is responsible for ensuring that all IT systems are running smoothly, from race data acquisition to team communications. She's known for her meticulous approach and her ability to remain calm and focused under pressure. Astrid believes that a well-functioning IT infrastructure is essential for a team's success, allowing them to analyze data, make informed decisions, and ultimately, gain a competitive edge. Her demanding nature ensures the team operates at peak efficiency. 

What makes Astrid stand out is her dedication to innovation. She is constantly seeking new ways to leverage technology to improve the team's performance, whether it's implementing new data analysis tools or developing custom software solutions.

physical.hairStyle: Short, layered bob with side-swept bangs
physical.description: Astrid has a slender build and a determined look.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and track system performance.
Insists on using a specific brand of ergonomic keyboard and mouse.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her desk when deep in thought.
